title: oxfmt 0.70.0 → 0.71.0 across three integrations
summary: A dependency-only change: the three integration packages (dsh, omp, opencode) each move their devDependency `oxfmt` from 0.70.0 to 0.71.0, and the lockfile is regenerated to match. The bump pulls in a new oxfmt release plus its transitive `tinypool` 2.1.2 → 2.2.0, and re-resolves all nineteen optional `@oxfmt/binding-*` platform binaries to 0.71.0. No application code, runtime path or published artifact changes; the blast radius is the developer/CI formatting step and the lockfile that pins it.
